name: @underlay/cli
description: The Underlay command line: a local repository in .underlay/, pulled and pushed with a registry.

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
